maria_cs: Quick sync — oxbow-health private VPC onboarding. Need status on networking peering, IAM roles, KMS key, and audit logs before next-week enablement workshop. Can we get a short runbook for any blockers?

olga_oxbow: Thanks — high level: peering request to our AWS account submitted yesterday, security team asked for a tighter CIDR. Waiting on your updated VPC CIDR.

maria_cs: Copy that. current proposal from infra: 10.10.0.0/22 for app subnets, 10.11.0.0/24 for mgmt. Devon, did you confirm overlap with Redwood's transit?

devon_infra: Not overlapping. We prefer /22 for throughput. For peering: please run this on your side when you accept:
```bash
aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc1234
```
Also need your route table updates and nat gateway info.

olga_oxbow: Will add routes. NATs are two AZs, using NAT-GW-a/b. ETA today.

pete_security: Quick notes on IAM/KMS: we need two cross-account IAM roles — one for the serving nodes (assume-role/redwood-serving) and one for audit log ingest (assume-role/redwood-logs). Please follow least-privilege.

pete_security: For KMS, we need a symmetric key with a grant to Redwood account id 987654321012. Also policy must include external key rotation allowed by our KMS admin. If you want customer-managed key, ensure key policy has: 
```json
{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/redwood-kms"},"Action":"kms:Decrypt"}]}
```
(we'll help review)

olga_oxbow: KMS team asked about HSM/HSM backed keys — they prefer AWS managed for now, but can switch. We'll share key ARN soon.

devon_infra: For audit logs, enable CloudTrail to deliver to a dedicated S3 bucket with object lock disabled but encryption enforced. Example bucket policy snippet we need from you to allow Redwood log ingestion: 
```json
{"Sid":"AllowRedwoodIngest","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/redwood-logs"},"Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::oxbow-ci-logs/*"}
```

olga_oxbow: Ok will provision bucket oxbow-ci-logs and post the ARN.

maria_cs: Great — two operational risks to call out: 1) delayed IAM role creation blocks service bootstrapping (renewal risk flag if not done by next Tue), 2) incomplete audit log path prevents compliance attestation. Both need owners.

olga_oxbow: Assign me owner for the VPC peering and bucket. KMS owner is in a different team — tagging ben_kms.

onboard-bot: CHECKLIST UPDATE: VPC_PEERING: in_progress; IAM_ROLES: pending; KMS_KEY: pending; AUDIT_BUCKET: in_progress; ENABLEMENT_SESSION: scheduled_2026-03-24_16:00_UTC

devon_infra: I'll draft the IAM role templates and post them here by EOD. Will include trust policy and minimal permissions for serving and logs.

pete_security: I'll review IAM + KMS policy once Devon posts. Also recommend enabling CloudTrail insights for anomalous activity during onboarding.

olga_oxbow: Thanks, will push NAT and bucket ARNs when done. One question: do you need our audit retention policy details for the enablement workshop?

maria_cs: Yes — bring retention, access window, and any current SLAs on access. We'll map to Redwood's default 90-day ephemeral logs + long-term S3 archival options.

olga_oxbow: Noted.

maria_cs: Action items summary: 1) Devon: IAM role templates + trust policies (owner). 2) Olga: push VPC route updates, NAT details, bucket & KMS ARNs (owner). 3) Pete: security review of IAM/KMS and CloudTrail settings. 4) Maria: enablement workshop deck + compliance checklist. Deadline: EOD tomorrow to keep renewal risk low.

devon_infra: ACK. I'll post templates and an example assume-role command: 
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/redwood-serving --role-session-name onboard-test
```

olga_oxbow: ACK. Expecting bucket ARN by 18:30 UTC.

pete_security: ACK. Will schedule a 30-min pre-review session before the workshop if needed.

maria_cs: Thanks team — syncing again tomorrow 09:00 UTC if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: REMINDER scheduled_checkin in 23h
